## Line 513

```plato

    // The struts whose midpoint lies inside a box. Whole struts are kept or
    // dropped — nothing is clipped, so the trimmed lattice keeps its welding and
    // a strut straddling the boundary survives or vanishes entire.
    Trimmed(struts: Array<Line3D>, region: Bounds3D): Array<Line3D>
        => struts.FlatMap(s => KeepSegment(region.Contains(s.Centroid), s));
```

```plato
    // The struts whose midpoint lies inside a solid described by a signed
    // distance field (distance <= 0, as Contains). Whole struts, as above.
    // Written through the interface member Eval, not Contains: the C# backend
    // emits Contains only for concrete implementers, so a call on this
    // interface-typed parameter would not compile (stdlib-460).
    Trimmed(struts: Array<Line3D>, solid: ISignedDistanceField3D): Array<Line3D>
        => struts.FlatMap(s => KeepSegment(solid.Eval(s.Centroid) <= 0.0, s));
```

```plato
    // The struts whose midpoint lies inside a solid described by a membership
    // predicate. Whole struts, as above; through Eval for the same reason.
    Trimmed(struts: Array<Line3D>, volume: IImplicitVolume3D): Array<Line3D>
        => struts.FlatMap(s => KeepSegment(volume.Eval(s.Centroid), s));
```
